mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ftp_download_task ( task_uuid, user_id, protocol, host, port, remote_path, display_name, status, total_bytes, downloaded_bytes, expected_sha256, revision, execution_epoch, retry_count, next_retry_at, last_error_code, last_error_message, completed_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted ) VALUES ( #{task.taskUuid}, #{task.userId}, #{task.protocol}, #{task.host}, #{task.port}, #{task.remotePath}, #{task.displayName}, #{task.status}, #{task.totalBytes}, #{task.downloadedBytes}, #{task.expectedSha256}, #{task.revision}, #{task.executionEpoch}, #{task.retryCount}, #{task.nextRetryAt}, #{task.lastErrorCode}, #{task.lastErrorMessage}, #{task.completedAt}, #{task.createdAt}, #{task.updatedAt}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ftp_download_task WHERE task_uuid = #{taskUuid} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM ftp_download_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM ftp_download_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT count(*) FROM ftp_download_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND status NOT IN ('PAUSED', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'NEEDS_RESTART', 'NEEDS_VERIFICATION', 'BLOCKED_CREDENTIALS')
mapper.update: UPDATE ftp_download_task SET status = 'CONNECTING', execution_epoch = execution_epoch + 1, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND revision = #{expectedRevision} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RETRY_WAIT')

UPDATE ftp_download_task SET status = #{status}, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_uuid = #{taskUuid} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND revision = #{expectedRevision}

UPDATE ftp_download_task SET status = #{status}, downloaded_bytes = #{downloadedBytes}, total_bytes = #{totalBytes}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND execution_epoch = #{executionEpoch} AND ((status = 'PAUSING' AND #{status} = 'PAUSED') OR status NOT IN ('PAUSING', 'PAUSED', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'NEEDS_RESTART', 'NEEDS_VERIFICATION', 'BLOCKED_CREDENTIALS', 'DELETING'))

UPDATE ftp_download_task SET downloaded_bytes = #{downloadedBytes}, total_bytes = #{totalBytes}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND execution_epoch = #{executionEpoch} AND status = 'DOWNLOADING'

UPDATE ftp_download_task SET status = 'QUEUED', total_bytes = NULL, downloaded_bytes = 0, retry_count = 0, next_retry_at = NULL, last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL, completed_at = NULL, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_uuid = #{taskUuid} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND revision = #{expectedRevision} AND status = 'PAUSING'
